description: Contact detail navigation interface with tabs for different aspects of contact information. Provides organized access to contact details, interactions, and related information.

pages.name: ContactTabsComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing all information related to a specific contact. It organizes various contact details into distinct, navigable tabs, allowing users to quickly access personal information, communication history, and other related data without leaving the contact's profile.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're looking for specific information about a contact, use the tabs at the top of the page to navigate between different sections. For example, personal details are typically under a 'Details' or 'Overview' tab, while communication history will be under an 'Interactions' or 'Activity' tab. The contact's photo and essential identifying information remain visible at the top of the screen regardless of which tab you're on. If you need to return to the list of contacts, look for a 'Back' button or a navigation link.
common_tasks: Viewing contact details: To see the primary information about the contact, such as their name, email, and phone number, click on the main 'Details' or 'Overview' tab.
Checking interactions: To review past communications, notes, or activities related to this contact, switch to the 'Interactions' or 'Activity' tab.
Navigating between sections: Simply click on the header of the desired tab (e.g., 'Details', 'Interactions', 'Files') to switch views and access different categories of information.

Going back to the contact list: To exit the individual contact's profile and return to the main list of contacts, use the 'Back' button, typically located in the top-left corner of the page or browser.
help_guidance.getting_started: When you first open a contact's profile, you will land on the default tab, usually 'Details' or 'Overview', which provides a summary of their information. To explore other aspects of the contact, such as their communication history or associated files, simply click on the respective tab. Each tab is designed to present a specific set of information in an organized manner.
